sources.entry: StealthGPT - Generates undetectable AI Content avoiding plagiarism issues. #paid

summary.name: StealthGPT
summary.one_liner: StealthGPT is a paid AI humanizer and rewriting tool that paraphrases AI-generated text so it aims to pass AI content detectors while keeping its meaning.
use_cases: humanizing ChatGPT or other AI drafts
rewriting AI text to pass AI detectors
polishing drafts for publication or submission
checking AI-written text with a built-in detector
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a workflow where users paste AI-generated text, the tool rewrites it at what it calls a model level to address perplexity, burstiness and other signals AI detectors measure, and then the output is checked with a built-in AI detector. It says it restructures sentences and rewords phrasing while keeping the original meaning. It also offers a document-level feature that generates drafts and lets users insert citations in chosen academic styles. The page claims in-house models trained on human writing and says it tests against detectors such as GPTZero, Originality, ZeroGPT and Winston AI. Testimonials and marketing claims such as a 99% bypass rate are the vendor's own statements and are not independently verified on the page.
notable: Rewrites AI text to target detectors such as GPTZero, Originality, ZeroGPT and Winston AI
Built-in AI detector to verify output before submitting
Document-level context awareness and citation insertion in academic styles
Claims a money-back guarantee on plans
caveats: Paid plans; the page lists plan options but no prices are stated in the text
Detector-bypass performance is the vendor's own claim (e.g. 99% bypass rate, 1.5M+ users) and is not independently verified
Using it to evade AI detection may conflict with academic integrity policies; the page itself suggests checking with other AIs rather than trusting its claims
